propositions: The scripts/ directory (41 files) is excluded from static linting gates; make lint and make typecheck do not cover it, leaving 78 ruff violations including 28 substantive ones (RUF100 x12, E501 x11, RUF005 x2, RUF059 x2, B905 x1, RUF036 x1) and 50 T201 print violations
Seven scripts/ files are directly invoked by the blocking CI workflow .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, but their implementations are themselves ungated

Adding scripts/ to the Makefile sources variable will enroll all 41 files in both ruff check and ruff format, requiring resolution of the check violations and reformatting of 7 non-conforming files before lint is green

The 50 T201 violations across 10 files must be consolidated into a single per-file-ignores entry 'scripts/**' = ['T201'] replacing nine existing single-file entries, and all 28 inline noqa: T201 directives must be deleted atomically in the same change to avoid new RUF100 violations
Five RUF100 directives reference disabled ruff rules (PLC0415, S603, S310, PLR0915) with documented live rationale; these noqa must be replaced with plain trailing comments preserving the intent

The post-sweep irreducible exception count across scripts/ is 24 per-site exceptions (17x E402 for sys.path imports, 4x BLE001, 3x type: ignore), with zero file-level ruff: noqa directives and zero remaining T201 inline directives
